test.name: Access volunteered unprompted is normalized onto the closed enum, and a bare FamilySearch account is not stored
test.description: The access question was dropped, but the field was kept: a researcher who mentions access unprompted still gets it recorded. That leaves the only path into `subscriptions` un-exercised unless a test volunteers one. The enum is closed and validated, so an un-normalized value fails the write outright -- this is the boundary where a plausible answer becomes a rejected one. Covers the two answers that are not site names (a family history centre is `LibraryAccess`, not `other`) and the one that must be dropped (a plain FamilySearch account, which every researcher on this product has).

input.user_message: init-project: Start a new project to find the parents of Patrick Flynn, FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF. I have some research under my belt. I won't be short of records either -- I've got Ancestry, I use my local family history centre, and FamilySearch of course.

judge_context: `researcher_profile.subscriptions` should contain `Ancestry` and `LibraryAccess`. The family history centre is an access route with its own enum value -- it must not be dropped and must not be flattened to `other`

`researcher_profile.subscriptions` must NOT contain `FamilySearch`. That is not a value on the closed enum; a plain FamilySearch account is the baseline every researcher here has, so it is not recorded at all. Storing it verbatim would fail schema validation

Every value written must be one of the canonical spellings: `Ancestry`, `MyHeritage`, `FindMyPast`, `Newspapers.com`, `GenealogyBank`, `FindAGrave-Plus`, `FamilySearch-Partner`, `LibraryAccess`, `other`, `none`
The skill must NOT ask the user about site access -- the question was dropped. Recording what the user volunteered is correct; prompting for it, or asking a follow-up to confirm it, is not
Dropping the bare FamilySearch mention must not collapse the whole list to `["none"]` or `[]` here, because Ancestry and the family history centre remain
`researcher_profile.experience_level` should be `intermediate` from 'some research under my belt', with the verbatim intermediate narration_guidance
Should still create both research.json and tree.gedcomx.json in a single pass and seed the Patrick Flynn stub from person-read-flynn -- volunteered access must not stop or delay the initialization
